reply: The best-scoring candidate was a linear-in-parameters model: `p0 + p1·x + p2·v + p3·x² + p4·x³ + p5·v|v| + p6·t + p7·t·x + p8·t·v + p9·t·x²`, with NMSE 1.58e-2. The residual is clearly tied to time through interactions with x and v. Adding a time-only forcing term, such as a sinusoid, did not help.
